about.en: Kekius Maximus (KEKIUS) is a community-driven meme token on Ethereum, named after the alias combining the Pepe the Frog meme with the gladiator Maximus that Elon Musk briefly used as his X display name in late 2024. It has no protocol utility beyond speculation and community identity. The token is the ERC-20 at 0x26E550AC11B26f78A04489d5F20f24E3559f7Dd9 with 9 decimals; several unrelated copycat tokens on Solana, Base and BNB Chain use the same name and ticker.
